gloss: to sprinkle over; to scatter on top of

definitions.gloss: to sprinkle over; to scatter on top of
definitions.explanation: To scatter a dry or fine-grained substance such as salt, spices, or sesame seeds onto the surface of food or another object.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふりかけ→ふりかけ：19214_furikake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける。
⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧コショウ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかけた。
examples.english: I sprinkled salt and pepper on the salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧{振|ふ}りかける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: Sprinkling plenty of grated cheese on top as a finishing touch greatly enhances the flavor.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to shake, scatter) + かける (to apply onto), meaning to sprinkle or scatter something onto a surface. Most commonly used in cooking contexts.

USAGE:
- Almost always used for dry or fine ingredients (salt, pepper, spices, cheese, sesame seeds)
- The noun ⟦ふりかけ→ふりかけ：19214_furikake⟧ (rice seasoning) derives from this verb
- Can also be used figuratively, e.g., ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける (to sprinkle water)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle salt
- ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle sesame seeds
- ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle grated cheese
- ⟦パセリ→パセリ：21585_paseri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle parsley
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかける: to sprinkle water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まぶす→まぶす：18477_mabusu⟧: to coat evenly; implies covering the entire surface
- ⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧: to scatter; broader meaning, not limited to cooking
- かける: to pour over; used for liquids rather than dry ingredients
